Build a sunlit, roofless factory workshop with a rectangular concrete floor, rear and side walls, and an open front leading to a loading yard. Arrange two parallel conveyor assembly lines with robotic arms and control desks at their ends, separated by a clear central aisle extending into the yard. Group a boiler, powder-storage unit, electrical cabinets, and pipes at the rear, beside a raised platform with railings and an access stair. Place shelving, boxes, pallets, and barrels along one side, with a forklift nearby and a pallet cart near the entrance. Use worn industrial surfaces and keep the production, utility, storage, and circulation areas distinct.
